title: Bob Beck at Ossining during the space kids experiments

tellings.quote: the story, like this guy Bob Beck, who was who was most certainly CIA, who was at the at Ossining at the time of these exact space kids experiments.

plain: In the 1970s a man named Bob Beck was present at Ossining, New York, at the very time of experiments with children that the teller calls the "space kids". An unnamed researcher on the show says this, without naming a source, and adds that Beck was "most certainly CIA", the US foreign intelligence agency, which would tie the agency to those experiments.
